scripts.bootstrap: npm ci && npm run build:sorting && npm ci --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.check: npm run build:sorting && npm run check:server && npm run check:backup && npm run check:release && node --check tests/interop/gateway-baseline.mjs && node --check tests/interop/baseline.mjs && node apps/obsidian/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tests/interop/tsconfig.json && npm run check --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.build: npm run build:sorting && npm run build:server && npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian && npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian --workspace self-hosted-livesync-cli
scripts.build:server: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && npm run build --workspace @tabularium/server
scripts.build:cli: npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian --workspace self-hosted-livesync-cli && node apps/server/build-cli.mjs
scripts.test:sorting:obsidian: npm run build:sorting && npm run build --prefix apps/obsidian && npm run test:tabularium:sorting --prefix apps/obsidian
scripts.test:release: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && node tests/release/clean-install.mjs
scripts.test:backup: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/backup/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:backup:clients: npm run build:notes && npm run build:cli && node tests/backup/clients.mjs
scripts.test:server:browser: npm run build:notes && npm run test:browser --workspace @tabularium/server
